2	category: other
3	requirement: '## Context
4	
5	
6	  Queue scheduling still exposes `SubTask.getLastBuiltOn` even though Jenkins no longer relies on it in a meaningful way, which encourages plugin authors to depend on stale behavior.
7	
8	
9	  ## Desired outcome
10	
11	
12	  Mark this API as deprecated and communicate that it is no longer part of the supported scheduling contract, without changing how queued work is assigned or how builds run today.
13	
14	
15	  ## Acceptance signals
16	
17	
18	  Existing callers still compile and run, the deprecated entry points remain available for compatibility, and normal build execution behavior stays unchanged.
19	
20	  '
